newsitem.title: USA: Group holds 5.77 pct Wendt-Bristol stake.
newsitem.headline: Group holds 5.77 pct Wendt-Bristol stake.

text.p: A group including Westlake, Ohio, investor Gerald Schroer said on Wednesday it has acquired a 5.77 percent stake or 330,500 common shares in Wendt-Bristol Health Services Corp, of Columbus, Ohio.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its stake includes 89,500 shares purchased in the past 60 days at prices ranging from $0.75 to $1.375 a share.

The group said it holds the stake for investment. It said it intends to discuss with Wendt-Bristol possible changes to the company's business plan, the restructuring of the nursing home component of the business and focusing business on diagnostic procedures.
